name: Glance
description: A start page that puts feeds, calendars, weather, release notes, monitors and bookmarks on one fast dashboard, all read from one YAML file. The template writes a starting page and switches Glance's own sign-in on; edit glance.yml in the config volume to build your own.

access.note: Glance asks for a user name and password, which the template writes into its configuration before the first start: sign in as admin with the generated GLANCE_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the Variables tab. The page, the password and the session key live in /app/config/glance.yml on the config volume, written once at the first deploy, so a password rotated in the Variables tab later does not change it; edit the file instead, and Glance reloads it.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the dashboard is opened at; nothing else here changes when it does.

volumes.name: config
volumes.purpose: glance.yml, the page layout and widget settings

install.content:
# Written by Just Dashboard before the first start. Glance reloads this file
# when it changes; edit it in the config volume to build your own pages.
server:
  proxied: true

auth:
  secret-key: {{secret.secret-key}}==
  users:
    admin:
      password: {{secret.admin-password}}

pages:
  - name: Home
    columns:
      - size: small
        widgets:
          - type: calendar
            first-day-of-week: monday
          - type: clock
            hour-format: 24h
      - size: full
        widgets:
          - type: hacker-news
            limit: 15
            collapse-after: 5
          - type: lobsters
            limit: 15
            collapse-after: 5
      - size: small
        widgets:
          - type: releases
            repositories:
              - glanceapp/glance

update.notes: glance.yml is written once, before the first start; a newer image never rewrites it, so read the release notes for renamed widget options.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: Administrator password
secrets.description: The admin account's password, written into glance.yml at the first deploy.

secrets.name: secret-key
secrets.label: Session key
secrets.description: Signs sign-in sessions; written into glance.yml with the base64 padding that makes it the 64-byte key Glance requires.
